required_environment.name: INDEXTTS_UPSTREAM_DIR
required_environment.purpose: Pinned clean IndexTTS2 checkout that supplies the imported inference package.

required_environment.name: RAW_TRAIN_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Raw training split used for grouped corpus audit.

required_environment.name: RAW_VALIDATION_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Raw validation split used for grouped corpus audit.

required_environment.name: RAW_TEST_JSONL
required_environment.purpose: Raw test split used for grouped corpus audit.

required_environment.name: PREPARED_DATA_ROOT
required_environment.purpose: Root containing every prepared feature and pair artifact consumed by training.

required_environment.name: DATASET_LINEAGE
required_environment.purpose: Content-addressed receipt binding audited splits to the prepared feature tree.

required_environment.name: TOKENIZER
required_environment.purpose: Pinned tokenizer file used for training and inference.

required_environment.name: CONFIG
required_environment.purpose: Pinned IndexTTS2 model and dataset configuration.

required_environment.name: BASE_CHECKPOINT
required_environment.purpose: Pinned base GPT checkpoint used to initialize full SFT.

required_environment.name: MODEL_DIR
required_environment.purpose: Pinned directory containing the remaining IndexTTS2 inference weights.

required_environment.name: SPEAKER
required_environment.purpose: Authorized reference-speaker audio for held-out synthesis.

required_environment.name: PERSISTED_PACKAGE_ROOT
required_environment.purpose: Existing external directory for immutable content-addressed lifecycle packages.

required_environment.name: SELECTED_CHECKPOINT_NAME
required_environment.purpose: Single safe checkpoint filename created under the training output.

required_environment.name: GENERATION_PLAN
required_environment.purpose: Frozen Instavar Voice generation plan containing this candidate.

required_environment.name: CANDIDATE_ID
required_environment.purpose: Candidate identifier present in the frozen generation plan.
